# Biblioteca de Motion Documental

Turn an everyday or vague animation request — in Portuguese first, English also accepted — into the right motion graphics effect for a faceless documentary-style video: 24 effects (entrances, rhythm/easing, text and numbers, shapes and transitions) each with its Portuguese name, its English technical term, and a default duration and easing, plus per-scene recipes for curiosity, history, mystery, science and documentary channels, a colour and theme system, and rules against ugly animation. Content is in Brazilian Portuguese; effect names are reported in both languages.
